Exact counterexample: V is the valuation ring of completed F_p((t^(1/p^infinity))), m its maximal ideal, W=V/(t), n=mW. The flat tensor square tilde n is m/tm; its map to n=m/(t) has nonzero kernel (t)/(tm). Identity of tilde n cannot factor through that quotient. Existing almost-pro quantifiers, coherent obstruction distinctions and corrected generic surjectivity checked; no additional finding on those.

findings.where: research/blueprint/papers/PAPER-BHATT-18.result.json, item almost-category, API AlmostElements.hom; imported PerfectoidSpaces:P0 general almost-base contract
findings.claim: The item assumes only m²=m and flatness of m⊗_V m, but asserts (N^a)_*=Hom_V(m,N). In this scope the right adjoint is Hom_V(m⊗_V m,N). The simpler formula cannot be extended from the flat valuation ideal to arbitrary base changes.
findings.evidence: Gabber–Ramero sixth release, https://websites.umich.edu/~bhattb/almost_purity_2011/almost_ring_theory.pdf, equation (2.2.4) p.12 and Proposition 2.2.13(ii) p.14 use tilde m=m⊗m; Remark 2.1.4 p.8 distinguishes flatness of m from flatness of tilde m. For V=K° with K=completed F_p((t^(1/p^infinity))), m its maximal ideal, W=V/(t), n=mW: tilde n≅m/tm is W-flat, while multiplication to n=m/(t) has kernel (t)/(tm)≅V/m≠0. For N=tilde n, its identity is absent from the comparison Hom_W(n,N)→Hom_W(tilde n,N). The report also distinguishes the representing modules by n-annihilated elements.
findings.fix: Correct the general API to Hom_V(tilde m,N), with its natural adjunction and counit. Derive Hom_V(m,N) only when multiplication tilde m→m is an isomorphism, in particular when m is flat. Preserve the general P0 base and the module/algebra adjoint distinction; do not exclude quotient bases by globally assuming m flat. Add valuation-base and V/(t) tests with the nonzero class of t in m/tm. Bhatt footnote 5 is valid over K°; record this as an extraction error, not a source erratum.

findings.claim: The new splitting roadmap is instructed to construct the mixed-characteristic coefficient ring again, despite the accepted André route assigning that common construction to R03.1. The item’s no-owner justification and route 9’s import-foundations boundary are inconsistent. This finding concerns the common coefficient input, not an assertion that the two full presentation conclusions coincide.
findings.evidence: BHATT cohen-structure first constructs W(k)→A0 inducing identity on the residue field and names DirectSummandsAndBigCohenMacaulay as owner. Accepted ANDRE route 4 at the same base names DeformationAndDerivedPatchingAlgebra:R03.1 and says “Add the exact Cohen presentation/compatibility”; cohen-parameter-presentation explicitly needs W(k) as coefficient ring for complete reduced p-torsion-free Noetherian local rings with perfect residue field. Bhatt’s complete regular mixed-characteristic input is in that overlap. The live R03.1 coefficient-category contract and reviewed AUDIT-17 identify the shared direction while retaining its missing interfaces.
